_comment: MACHINE-READABLE CAPTURE. Every frame here is a real capture, not a
synthetic one, and each entry names where it was taken and what it
establishes. tests/vendor_capture_oracle.rs decodes each frame per the
wire format documented in VENDOR_UI_MAP.md and asserts the claim.
PROVENANCE, and what could not be done: the knob (514c:8850) was NOT
attached when this fixture was assembled, so no NEW capture was taken.
`antiknob raw` refuses outright in that state -- it answers 'Device is
connected wirelessly. Hardware configuration ... requires a direct USB-C
wired connection' -- and tools/hidsnoop/ needs the vendor app driving that
same absent device. No frame below was invented to fill the gap. They are
transcribed from the capture log already committed in VENDOR_UI_MAP.md,
which is this repo's own primary record of what ANTICATER.app sent, with
the method written down in that file. The `doc_line` field is where each
frame appears there, and the test asserts every frame is present in that
document, so the prose and this file cannot drift apart unremarked.
`reproduce` says how the repo's own code emits these bytes. `decode-only`
means the frame is something the DEVICE sent (a read reply) or something
the code deliberately no longer produces -- both are asserted, not
skipped: see the test's assertions on 'no_longer_produced'.

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, EXPERIMENT 1, one distinct MutiMedia action per zone, Save settings pressed
captures.establishes: twist CCW is firmware key id 2; one media action is 2 bytes of payload at byte 6

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, EXPERIMENT 1, centre zone
captures.establishes: press is firmware key id 3; 0x006f is consumer Screen brightness+

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, EXPERIMENT 1, top-right zone
captures.establishes: twist CW is firmware key id 4; 0x00cd is Play/Pause

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, EXPERIMENT 1, lower-left zone
captures.establishes: hold + twist LEFT is firmware key id 5, and 0x0070 is consumer Screen brightness-

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, EXPERIMENT 1, lower-right zone
captures.establishes: hold + twist RIGHT is firmware key id 6. The usage is 0x0092, chosen by the capture run BECAUSE its high byte is non-zero, which is what later proved a media usage really is 16-bit

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, EXPERIMENT 1, the single commit sent once after all five records
captures.establishes: key writes are committed by a separate 0xFD FE FF tail, sent once after all five records rather than once per record

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, 'View settings' pressed -- a device READ-BACK, not a save
captures.establishes: the whole slot table is three queries, not one per slot: width 0x19 = 25, counters 1..3, one per LAYER

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, 'View settings' pressed
captures.establishes: counter 2, same width -- the burst walks layers, not slots

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, 'View settings' pressed
captures.establishes: counter 3 completes the table; three is the whole thing

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, clicking 'LED Mode3' in the RGB LED group
captures.establishes: a mode button sets the LAYER's backlight, it does not bind a gesture; the trailing palette bytes were not captured here

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, same click -- layers 1 and 2 always follow at mode 0
captures.establishes: the vendor writes all three layers, not just the one clicked

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, same click
captures.establishes: and layer 2 at mode 0, completing the set of three: the vendor writes every layer, not only the one whose button was clicked

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, first packet of any LED interaction
captures.establishes: an LED write is only honoured after this init; without it the firmware stores the mode, reads it back correctly, and changes nothing

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, nineteen letters clicked in a row, saved as ONE record
captures.establishes: keyboard actions DO chain: nineteen letters saved as ONE record, byte 6 = 0x13 = 19, so a gesture can type a sequence. Only five of the nineteen entries were written down, so what is checkable is the length field and the visible head

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, 'a', a 500 ms delay box, then 'b'
captures.establishes: the per-step delay is 16-bit BIG-ENDIAN across one entry: 0x01F4 = 500, sitting in the delay bytes of the entry that follows it. 0x01F4 does not fit in one byte, which is what proved the field is two bytes wide rather than a guess

captures.source: this repo's OWN writer, run against the hardware to bypass the vendor app entirely
captures.establishes: what this tool wrote for a two-action media sequence. The second usage is Calculator (0x0192), chosen so its non-zero HIGH byte rules out trailing-zero trimming
captures.no_longer_produced: a media record holding more than one action is REFUSED by fd::build_packet, because the firmware truncates it. This frame is the evidence for that refusal and the test asserts the refusal stands

captures.source: the device's answer to the frame above, on the same handle
captures.establishes: the DEVICE dropped the second action: len came back 02 and the Calculator bytes are gone. A media slot holds exactly one action -- the firmware refuses, not the vendor app

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, EXPERIMENT 2, two media actions set in the UI
captures.establishes: byte 6 is a payload LENGTH in bytes (4 = two media actions) while only the LAST action is present in the bytes that follow. Chaining did not round-trip

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, EXPERIMENT 2, three media actions set in the UI
captures.establishes: six declared bytes, one action actually written: 2 x action count, confirming the length field is not an entry count

captures.source: the OWNER's capture of the knob as it arrived from the factory, with Volume+ bound to hold+twist RIGHT
captures.establishes: byte 5 is 01 here and 00 in every frame this repo's own writer produces. Chaining demonstrably works on this hardware, so byte 5 is the missing piece -- the most likely reading is the action's index within the sequence. NOT a solved question

captures.source: an 0xFA read-back of the knob's factory keymap, before this repo wrote anything
captures.establishes: the shape a WORKING record has: kind 01, byte 6 declaring 1 entry, and the payload in the three-byte entry array from byte 7

captures.source: an 0xFA read-back of what this repo's 0xFE single-action writer used to flash
captures.establishes: len = 0 and the payload at bytes 10-12, where the firmware never looks. The device STORED this and returned it byte-for-byte, so every read-back 'confirmed' the write while it executed zero entries. An FA read proves storage, never effect
captures.no_longer_produced: keyboard and media single actions go out as 0xFD; the test asserts this exact frame is not what Action::to_packet writes for the same action

captures.source: the device's answer to the LED init packet, on the handle that had just written a mode
captures.establishes: byte 2 of this echo is 00. A read-back that took the first report it was offered therefore read mode 0 -- 'off' -- for a write that had worked, every time, which is why get_led looked fine while write-then-verify looked broken

captures.source: the 0xFA B0 mode query's real reply, reached only after the init echo above was skipped
captures.establishes: the reply is framed 03 FA <mode> <48 bytes of palette>, so the mode is byte 2. This one reports 02 = green

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, values typed into the DelaySetting spin boxes
captures.establishes: bytes 7..15 for delays 123, 50, 50: 0x007B = 123 big-endian, then two 0x0032 = 50. The seventeen default 50s are why early captures were full of 00 32 00 groups -- they were never padding, they are unused entries each carrying a 50 ms default

captures.source: ANTICATER.app under tools/hidsnoop, a triple-click failed to select the box contents so the typed digits APPENDED
captures.establishes: 0xC418 = 50200 and 0x01FD = 509. The accident is what proved the field is 16-bit: a one-byte delay could not hold 50200
